description: Local requirements for the EliD OAuth 2.1 client library.

dos: Provide a native ESM client library for integrating Node.js applications with EliD issuer-scoped OAuth 2.1 services.
Define a tested public API for issuer discovery, PKCE authentication, token exchange, and session management before release.
Keep package identity and metadata aligned with eliware/elid-client.
donts: Do not present the inherited greeting sample as EliD client functionality.
Do not document or publish client behavior until the implementation and tests establish it.
